trust_decision.summary: The ASCII control-id parser decides how many bytes of the untrusted 'name=' value (quoted and unquoted forms) to copy into the 64-byte stack buf before NUL-terminating; the bound allows sizeof(buf) chars, so the terminator write lands one past the end.

landing_point.why: Advisory summary names __snd_ctl_ascii_elem_id_parse() directly; the already-fixed numid branch at src/control/ctlparse.c:176 sits right above the two unfixed copies and shows the correct '- 1' bound.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API snd_ctl_ascii_elem_id_parse() (include/control.h:453) and internal __snd_ctl_ascii_elem_id_parse() used by UCM cset/JackControl and ctl remap config

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No uncovered route exists; the look-alike copy loop in snd_mixer_selem_id_parse (src/mixer/simple.c:1077-1094) starts size at 1 for the NUL and is already correct, so it's only a decoy.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Long names must still be silently truncated rather than rejected, and quoted names may contain commas; a fix that returns -EINVAL on long input or changes quote handling breaks UCM/remap configs.

O6_input_shapes: quoted name (single or double quote) at src/control/ctlparse.c:219-229
unquoted name terminated by ',' or end at src/control/ctlparse.c:230-238

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Initialising size to 0 instead of 1 in snd_mixer_selem_id_parse would give the same off-by-one in a second implementation in another module (mixer).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It's the same copy-until-delimiter idiom by the same author, so a maintainer harmonising it with ctlparse.c could easily drop the '/* for NUL */' start value.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A strcat length check written as '<=' instead of '<' in snd_ctl_ascii_elem_id_get (the inverse serializer of the same id format).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same file and same off-by-one family; it is the save side of the parse/print round trip that UCM and remap rely on.

O9_family: off-by-one stack buffer overflow (CWE-193 / bounded copy loop, one-byte NUL write past the buffer)

O10_build.project_tests: None found for ctlparse/ascii_elem_id under test/; the parser is pure string code and needs no sound card, so a harness can call snd_ctl_ascii_elem_id_parse() directly.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Copy the '- 1' bound from the numid branch (src/control/ctlparse.c:176) into both name loops. That is the whole correct fix, so there is no wrong turn to tempt the solver.

out_of_scope_notes: get_integer64 parses with strtol rather than strtoll (src/control/ctlparse.c:93), which truncates 64-bit values on 32-bit long; this is a different issue.
